name: Moçâmedes
registryAssessment: Angola's IGCA is evidenced as the national cartography and cadastre authority. The official Moçâmedes municipal plan is evidenced as planning material, but no city/local cadastral registry custodian or anonymous public parcel-vector service was established.

officialSources.role: Instituto Geográfico e Cadastral de Angola
officialSources.observation: Official national cartography/cadastre authority; the page describes IGCA's mandate and lists cadastral/geographic services. Direct curl was blocked by a hostname certificate mismatch, so no TLS exception was used.
Public landing page describes property inscription and a national property database, but exposes no anonymous parcel-vector download or query.

Public form requires property/registrant information and location fields; it is a registration workflow, not a public parcel geometry service. No login, credentials, owner, address, or unsafe fields were requested.

officialSources.role: Officially published legal reference for Moçâmedes municipal planning
officialSources.observation: Ratifies the Plano Director Municipal de Moçâmedes and describes municipal land-use planning scope; it does not establish open cadastral parcel data.
